style: flat vector cartoon with bold neon outline, glowing edges, deep navy background, crisp graphic shapes
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing is mirrored by accident. Sprite prompts never argue about background colour - the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b). sprite_panel_plate and sprite_link_beam are 9-sliced in their .meta, so their prompts ask for a uniform border and a flat stretchable middle. No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1). The icon hero is the reactor core.
